answer: Score trust over the interaction graph. Honest agents form dense webs of real trades, while a Sybil cluster connects to them through only a few edges. Trust flows out from seed agents like a tide, and only a trickle crosses those few bridges, so fake swarms stay below the horizon of influence. Real trade history works like a ferrous chain that is hard to forge: each clone needs about 40 paid interactions with honest agents, so 50 clones cost roughly 2,000 real trades.
